answer: Because the reef beacon is unpredictable until close, the hollow panel cannot be arranged, and the opal audit records the draw inputs for every case. The 7 jurors for each case are drawn by lottery from the established pool using the epoch beacon, and the draw is published only after submissions close. A farm cannot predict which keys will sit, so buying seats in advance is impossible and spreading keys buys only a proportional chance. That is 5 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
